import json,struct
m=json.load(open('/app/out.json'))
d=open('/app/a.out','rb').read()
# independent parse
phoff=struct.unpack_from('<Q',d,32)[0]; phnum=struct.unpack_from('<H',d,56)[0]; ents=struct.unpack_from('<H',d,54)[0]
BASE=0x400000
exp={}
relocs=set()
shoff=struct.unpack_from('<Q',d,0x28)[0]; shents=struct.unpack_from('<H',d,0x3a)[0]; shnum=struct.unpack_from('<H',d,0x3c)[0]
for i in range(shnum):
    o=shoff+i*shents
    typ=struct.unpack_from('<I',d,o+4)[0]
    if typ in (4,9):
        off=struct.unpack_from('<Q',d,o+24)[0]; size=struct.unpack_from('<Q',d,o+32)[0]; es=struct.unpack_from('<Q',d,o+56)[0] or (24 if typ==4 else 16)
        for p in range(off,off+size,es): relocs.add(struct.unpack_from('<Q',d,p)[0])
for i in range(phnum):
    o=phoff+i*ents
    t,fl,off,va,pa,fs,ms,al=struct.unpack_from('<IIQQQQQQ',d,o)
    if t!=1: continue
    for j in range(0,min(fs,ms)-3,4):
        a=BASE+va+j
        if any(a<=BASE+r+7 and BASE+r<=a+3 for r in relocs): continue
        exp[str(a)]=struct.unpack_from('<I',d,off+j)[0]
print('match:', m==exp, 'ours',len(m),'independent',len(exp))
# coverage vs memsz-based reference estimate
words_memsz=sum((ms)//4 for t,fl,off,va,pa,fs,ms,al in (struct.unpack_from('<IIQQQQQQ',d,phoff+i*ents) for i in range(phnum)) if t==1)
print('memsz words',words_memsz,'coverage %.1f%%'%(100*len(m)/words_memsz))
print('json size',len(open('/app/out.json').read()))
# types check
print('all int values:', all(isinstance(v,int) for v in m.values()))
print('all str keys:', all(isinstance(k,str) for k in m))
EOF
